query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `viral_topics` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `seo_client_id` int NOT NULL,
  `topic` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `content_type` enum('youtube_longform','short_form','blog_post') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'short_form',
  `platform` varchar(100),
  `viral_score` int,
  `search_volume` int,
  `difficulty` int,
  `hook` text,
  `key_points` text,
  `competitor_urls` text,
  `research_notes` text,
  `status` enum('researched','scripted','in_production','ready','posted','archived') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'researched',
  `week_of` date,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `social_posts` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `seo_client_id` int NOT NULL,
  `viral_topic_id` int,
  `content_package_id` int,
  `platform` enum('facebook','instagram','tiktok','youtube','youtube_shorts') NOT NULL,
  `post_type` enum('video','reel','short','image','carousel','text') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'video',
  `caption` text,
  `hashtags` text,
  `video_url` text,
  `thumbnail_url` text,
  `scheduled_at` timestamp NULL,
  `posted_at` timestamp NULL,
  `platform_post_id` varchar(255),
  `status` enum('draft','ready','scheduled','posted','failed') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
  `error_message` text,
  `notes` text,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `content_calendar` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `seo_client_id` int NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(500) NOT NULL,
  `content_type` enum('youtube_longform','short_form','blog_post','email','social_image') NOT NULL,
  `platforms` text,
  `scheduled_date` date NOT NULL,
  `viral_topic_id` int,
  `social_post_id` int,
  `content_package_id` int,
  `status` enum('planned','in_production','ready','posted','skipped') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'planned',
  `notes` text,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `heygen_sessions` (
  `id` int AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  `seo_client_id` int NOT NULL,
  `token` text NOT NULL,
  `cookies` text,
  `token_type` varchar(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cookie',
  `expires_at` timestamp NULL,
  `is_active` int NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  `last_used_at` timestamp NULL,
  `captured_by` int,
  `created_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
